messages.subject: Troubleshooting in R mini-workshop at D-RUG this week
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies! 

We will be meeting this Thursday (10/16) from 10-noon virtually and in person in the DataLab classroom (Library 360). This week Elise is running a mini-workshop on troubleshooting strategies in R during the first portion of D-RUG: 

Everyone get stuck with their coding in R. Whether it's an error message or just nonsene ouputs, it happens to all of us. The key is learning how to get yourself unstuck. This mini-workshop will cover practical strategies you can take to get yourself out of even the most egregious R binds.

Afterwards we will continue with our open session format!

D-RUG: 10am-noon, DataLab Classroom, Library 360, and zoom https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09
